hiddenSurfacePrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Actual hidden-surface source drawing for a layered 2D animation rig, NOT a preview.
Input image: the approved C low sandstone den, the exact appearance authority. Produce the stationary LOWER BASE ONLY by removing ONLY the broad top roof slab. Preserve the original square canvas, original camera, every visible lower-base pixel's position and proportions, golden ochre palette, teal outlines, upper-left light, brushwork, low dark recessed interior floor and small pebbles at both feet. Do not recenter, resize, crop, redesign, or move any existing lower part.
Complete the two stone supports where their tops and upper backs were hidden by the removed roof: give each a solid fully closed rounded angular contour continuing a modest distance upward into the former roof region, with matching sandstone top surfaces. Paint the dark inner rear cavity behind the supports so that it remains visually complete when the roof is tipped up by a few degrees. The base must be a complete independent reusable source drawing that can sit underneath the original roof slab. Keep the original low floor shape and ground contact exactly registered. The central opening remains empty. Keep a large clear transparent area ABOVE the completed supports; no replacement roof, bridge, cap, or slab.
One asset, original full square registration. Genuine transparent alpha background. No text, labels, arrows, grid, effects, glow, eggs, creatures, new props, grass, terrain tile or external cast shadow. Match the approved lower silhouette exactly.
